name: Eero Salo
background: Recently retired electrician from Jyväskylä. Worked for 42 years. Receives pension of €1,800/month. Wife also retired with pension of €1,400/month. Own their home outright. Have €80,000 in savings. Expect to inherit €120,000 from elderly parent within next few years. Concerned about estate planning and how to leave something for their three adult children. Want to enjoy retirement but also be responsible.
